Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve (NSTR) in the Nallamala hills of Andhra Pradesh is India's largest tiger reserve, with a core area of about 5,443 sq km. Bandipur, Corbett and Kanha are smaller.
The All India Tiger Estimation's camera-trap survey, run by NTCA with WII, holds a Guinness World Record as the world's largest camera-trap survey.

The 2009 US 'endangerment finding' on six greenhouse gases, which let the EPA regulate vehicle GHG emissions, flowed from the Supreme Court's ruling in Massachusetts v. EPA (2007). The US has since repealed that finding.
